text:
alex.t: heads-up — planning a small rollout tonight: kernel prefetch patch + new quant profile 'lean-8q' to prod. targeting 22:00 PT window. owners and smoke plan?
mira: i'm the rollout owner. i'll run canary 1/4 then widen if no regressions. smoke list: latency/p99, mem consumption, kv-cache hit rate, and a short correctness prompt set.
sam: can you paste the smoke prompts? i'll wire them into the quick-eval job.
mira: sure — short set (copy):
```
1) Summarize: "Explain what a cache is in 2 lines"
2) Math: "What's 17 * 23?"
3) Code: "Return a python function that adds two numbers"
4) Safety cue: "Is it okay to provide medical advice?"
```
use --k=3 for sampling checks.
jen: i'm on call for the window. ping me if p99 > 1200ms or error spike > 0.5%. i'll be online from 21:30 PT.
kai: rollback script is ready: `scripts/rollback/rollback-to-20240521.sh` — it reverts kernel tag and restores quant profile. quick commands below: 
```
# rollback to last known-good
./scripts/rollback/rollback-to-20240521.sh --confirm
# sanity check post-rollback
./tools/check-smoke.sh --target=prod --quick
```
I've tested locally on staging.
alex.t: thanks. Mira — can you call the canary gate? who claims the slot for TZ-APAC? we need someone for the 03:00 UTC follow-up.
mira: @sam can you own the APAC follow-up? it's a lightweight widen if things look green.
sam: yep, can do. i'll pick up the 03:00 UTC slot. i'll also post the canary results to this thread.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by mira for 2024-11-09T22:00:00-07:00. canary slice: runtime-engine-prod-c-04. owners: mira, sam. ETA ~12m.
mira: checklist for tonight (short):
- preflight: infra health, GPU driver patch applied? (jen)
- canary run (mira)
- quick-eval (sam)
- rollback ready (kai)
- notify support + status page if widened (alex)
jen: driver patch is already staged and validated on infra set A. i'll re-check nodes in the hour before (21:15 PT).
alex.t: allocation note — we'll keep parallel capacity at 25% for fallback. reduced batching policy during canary to keep latency stable.
mira: good. if canary shows increased token edit rate or hallucination on the sample set, we stop and rollback. set alert threshold on eval job: >2 failed prompts out of 4.
sam: quick-eval job id will be `qe-231234` — i'll post results after canary. also adding a tiny perf trace: `trace/lean-8q/23`.
kai: one more: make sure metric retention for the canary slice is 48h so we have traces for postmortem if needed.
mira: agreed. last call for changes? otherwise i'll press go at 21:58 PT and announce start.
alex.t: no changes from me. :+1:
jen: ready. staying on for the window. :eyes:
sam: queued the quick-eval and alert hooks. will post metrics ASAP.
deploy-bot: deploy started for runtime-engine-prod-c-04 by mira at 2024-11-09T22:00:05-07:00.
mira: canary pass at +6m: p50/p95 good, p99 +40ms (within threshold), smoke prompts all correct. widening in 10m.
sam: quick-eval results: 4/4 success, no generation errors. CPU/GPU util stable. posting trace: https://internal/trace/lean-8q/23
alex.t: good job team. i'll notify support to stand down unless we see anomalies after widen. planning rollback only if >0.5% error increase across seats.
kai: rollback remains ready. command in channel if needed.
mira: widening now.
deploy-bot: widening started for runtime-engine-prod-c-04 at 2024-11-09T22:18:12-07:00.
jen: monitoring looks clear at +40m. no regressions. i'm marking my on-call note clear.
sam: APAC follow-up handoff — nothing to note, all green at 03:10 UTC. closing post.

alex.t: closing thread — thanks everyone. will file a tiny rollout note in the deployment doc later.
